plugins.name: auto-session-title
plugins.description: Names the session with a short model-written summary of the first prompt.

plugins.name: ado-pr-status
plugins.description: Fetches the current branch's Azure DevOps PR in the background for the ccstatusline widget.

plugins.name: ado-link-bar
plugins.description: Links in the band above the prompt to the Azure DevOps pull requests and work items mentioned most recently in the conversation.

plugins.name: toast-notify
plugins.description: Windows toast notifications when a long turn or command finishes, when Claude waits for permission, when a turn stalls, and when a turn fails. Inside an rdpmanager RDP session they go to the client instead.

plugins.name: bang-history
plugins.description: Appends commands run with ! in Claude Code to the PowerShell (PSReadLine) history file.

plugins.name: cmdHistory
plugins.description: /cmdHistory lists PowerShell (PSReadLine) history in a pane and puts the picked command in the prompt as a ! shell command.
